shared_or_similar_visual_information: A lens bounded by the arcs of two overlapping circles. On the left, use the tan lens labeled 37 between the Action and Comedy circles. On the right, use the unshaded lens between the two outer crescents of the equal-circle diagram.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The lens represents moviegoers who like both genres. Right image: The lens is the geometric intersection of the two disks, crossing the line AB along CD.
Rationales: The left lens encodes simultaneous membership of the listed population or elements. The right lens represents a continuous geometric overlap between two disks.
